title: aethusa cynapium subsp. agrestis
intro: Aethusa cynapium subsp. agrestis, commonly known as Wild Carrot, is a plant species within the parsley family (Apiaceae). It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antispasmodic to alleviate cramps and muscle spasms. The therapeutic actions of Wild Carrot include its emmenagogic properties, helping to regulate menstrual cycles, and its diuretic action, which aids in the treatment of urinary issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
